title: Pre-Checks and Post-Checks
description: Runs the pre-check and the post-check of an infrastructure change: the playbook in check mode with a live log, then back to the change request.
insights: Infrastructure Operations hands a change request to this Space. The pre-check runs the playbook in check mode (nothing is changed) and returns the verdict to the change request.
After the upgrade the same Space runs the post-check: service health, new certificate, dependent systems and monitoring.
Fictional sample data and a simulated run. In operation AWX runs the Ansible job template and n8n collects the result.
prompt: Bundled example: Pre-Checks and Post-Checks (static, data and model embedded by npm run sync:infra-ops).
